results.title: Long Bright Shimmer Pad
results.author: bassimat
results.description: The longest sound in the set at 2.7 seconds — a semi-tonal bright shimmer pad with 68% high-frequency energy and a peak near 8 kHz. Airy and spacious, useful as a texture or pad layer. Generated with Relic Waves on iPad.

results.description: Fashion Shimmer - Luxury Runway Percussion Stinger Made with Drumart SLD VST by Electronik Sound Lab.
